question: Who is the author of the book ‘Languages of Truth: Essays 2003-2020’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Salman Rushdie.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book ‘Languages of Truth: Essays 2003-2020’ is written by **Salman Rushdie.**
 
• He is a renowned **British-Indian author** known for** "Midnight's Children"** and the **controversial novel "The Satanic Verses."**
 
• **Languages of Truth: Essays 2003-2020 **is a collection of essays written by Rushdie over seventeen years, exploring literature, politics, culture, and personal experiences.
 
• He has also won the Booker Prize for** "Midnight's Children". ​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vikram Sampath**

 
 
• He is an** Indian author, historian, and musician** known for his contributions in the field of** literature and historical research**.
 
• He is also the author of acclaimed books such as** "Splendours of Royal Mysore: The Untold Story of the Wodeyars" and "My Name is Gauhar Jaan! The Life and Times of a Musician."**
 
• He accomplished **classical musician specializing in Indian classical vocals**, particularly in the** Kirana gharana tradition.**
 
• Founded the **Archive of Indian Music, a non-profit organization **dedicated to preserving and promoting India's rich musical heritage.
